The form must be submitted to the Registration Unit, Internal Security Section, Criminal Division, Department of Justice, Washington, D.C. 20530. The filing of this document is required by the Foreign Agents Registration Act of 1938, as amended, 22 U.S.C. § 611 et seq., for the purposes of registration under the Act and public disclosure. Provision of the information requested is mandatory, and failure to provide this information is subject to the penalty and enforcement provisions established in Section 8 of the Act. Compliance is accomplished by filing an electronic amendment to registration statement and uploading any supporting documents at http://www.fara.gov.

task_query.query: Which fields must be captured on every registration form, and in what format must each be written?
memories: For all registration forms, the Signer Name must be captured and recorded exactly as provided, including full name and any middle initials, as a required field
For all registration forms, the Registrant Name must be recorded in uppercase letters exactly as written in the original document, as a required field
For all future document entries, the registrant name and file date must be captured and recorded on every form, as explicitly required by the user
For all registration forms, the File Date must be recorded in the format YYYY-MM-DD, with no abbreviations or variations, as a required field
User has specified that the form must be filed for any changes to a registration, and this instruction must be preserved as a rule for future document capture.
For all registration forms, the Registration Number must be entered as a continuous number without separators, as a required field

For all future document entries, the registrant name, file date, and registration number must be captured and recorded on every form, as explicitly required by the user, and this instruction applies to the Tourism Authority of Thailand entry
